medium: photographic: the object of the story held up in a hand close to the lens, tinted archival photos, vintage prints flat on black; the creator on camera in a brick home office
avoid: illustration, vector, cartoon, 3D render, plain studio white background, text baked into the image
note: Only one video on file. The creator holding the object up to camera is the signature; the object-in-hand look carries it without his face. Film stills are real movie frames, never generated. Caption: small white sans in a translucent dark box, lower-middle.

looks.label: Creator on camera with the object
looks.when: the creator on camera - never generated.

looks.label: Object held up to the lens
looks.when: the thing the script is about - a product, a package, a tool, a piece of paper - shown as a real object held up close.
looks.prompt: A photograph of the object held up in one hand close to the lens, filling most of the frame, shallow focus, warm daylight from a window, a brick wall and shelves soft and dark behind; the printed surface of the object crisp as texture with no legible words; natural, slightly warm colour.

looks.label: Tinted archival photo
looks.when: a place, a factory, a company, a street from the past - shown as an old photograph.
looks.prompt: An old colour photograph of the place from decades ago, faded to a magenta-pink cast like aged film, soft grain, washed-out highlights, taken from the street at eye level, no people close to camera, no text.

looks.label: Vintage print flat on black
looks.when: an old advert, poster, package or printed page from the period.
looks.prompt: A vintage printed poster or package laid flat on a plain black background, photographed straight on in soft even light, period colours and halftone texture, paper edges and slight creases visible, any lettering as illegible marks.

looks.label: Movie still
looks.when: a quoted scene from a named film - real footage only, never generated.
